projects.title: Ludicly
projects.description: Ludicly is an education app where you can study for your tests through games. The thing that makes it stand out is that you can make sets(lists of questions) by just uploading a picture of your notes or uploading files like PDFs and then you get a custom set made by AI, the set can later be studied through one of our games or a traditional method like for example flashcards.

about: I started programming when I was 8 years old, and I have been building things ever since. It has always been my biggest passion because you get a lot of freedom and get to make real stuff.
It began with Roblox Studio, where I made my own games and learned Blender to build the 3D models for them.
Then I learned C# and Java to make simple terminal apps like calculators, little tests and other small projects to learn both languages.
After I learned Java and C#, I tried Unity 3D since I knew the programming language and tried Unreal Engine shortly after.
These days I don't make games anymore. I build apps, websites and software with Flutter, React, React Native, TypeScript.

Lately I have been getting into business (especially SaaS) and it has been going pretty well so far. I always had a mindset for money, for example even in my Roblox days I was working commission for other developers and that's also why I don't have any actual games built.
